name: The village school

layers.essential_history: [[c:Polebrook's Church of England primary school is on Main Street.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:During the war, village children grew used to the roar of B-17 bombers overhead.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:The schoolchildren found a page of a notebook in the playground, written in a code they couldn't read.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:The notebook code]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:A is 1, B is 2, C is 3, and so on.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Who wrote the notebook? (job)]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:The coded notebook page belongs to the salesman.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head east, about 210 metres as the crow flies, to Lutton Road.  Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
